title: Explorative analysis of cytokine expression bei chronic venous disease and insufficiency
summary: Diese Studie untersucht die Expression von Zytokinen in verschiedenen Stadien der chronisch venösen Erkrankung.
conditions: Varicose veins of lower extremities without ulcer or inflammation
Varicose veins of lower extremities with both ulcer and inflammation

interventions.name: Patients with chronic venous disease or insufficiency

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Chronic venous insufficiency, Stages C2/C4/C6
Exclusion criteria:
Antikoagulant
Active malignancy
Adipositas grade ≥ 1
Relevant comorbities
Chronic autoimmune disorders
History of deep vein thrombosis
